learnings.segment_field: Server-side audience state, read-only to client. Always safe to send []. Server assigns stable per-topic 4eyes_ IDs after generate (e.g. 4eyes_101950=WM Services, 4eyes_122122=Mgmt Consulting, 4eyes_121448=Computer Telephony). Client echoes back whatever server stored from last generate, but server doesn't validate it.
learnings.netWorth_prefix: Single $ (e.g. '$500,000 to $749,999'). Verified from Shaw's browser capture on fresh audience. The $$ in some chat messages is markdown LaTeX rendering eating one $.
learnings.router_state_tree: MUST be encodeURIComponent()'d before setting as header value.
learnings.audience_reuse: Can re-generate existing audience with new filters. Button changes to 'Update Audience'. Same Generate action ID.
learnings.action_ids_stable: Action IDs don't always change with deployments. Only re-capture if getting 404.
